title: 退税备案单证与留存期限
summary_zh: 第四十五至四十七条覆盖备案单证：申报后十五日内整理，列明存放方式；成交方式没有对应单证的情形有例外，可按规定以相似资料替代，通常保存十年。
summary_en: Articles 45–47 specify supporting trade records, a 15-day post-filing organization requirement and ten-year retention unless otherwise provided. Transaction-specific exceptions and equivalent evidence must remain attached to the requirement.
tradex_workflow: After a confirmed filing event, propose a document-completion follow-up; show missing contracts or transport evidence and applicable exceptions.
cash_effect: Missing evidence can delay or jeopardize a refund; do not invent a refund payment date.
title_en: Export refund records and retention periods
source_title: 出口业务增值税和消费税退（免）税管理办法

退税备案单证与留存期限
第四十五至四十七条覆盖备案单证：申报后十五日内整理，列明存放方式；成交方式没有对应单证的情形有例外，可按规定以相似资料替代，通常保存十年。
Articles 45–47 specify supporting trade records, a 15-day post-filing organization requirement and ten-year retention unless otherwise provided. Transaction-specific exceptions and equivalent evidence must remain attached to the requirement.
